acceptedInterpretation: The request is a latency refactor of the routine validate execution path only: reuse the existing keyed scheduler so the configured command plan runs concurrently under declared resource claims, with identical per-command results. It is not a request to change which commands run, to speed up any individual command (quorum-submit-smoke.js stays as is and is the 271s floor), to raise the full-suite worker count, or to reorder done_prepare phases.
notes: Collision was triggered by structural multi-deliverable intent plus a material-code behaviour change. The competing reading was "make closeout faster" in general, which would have pulled in the quorum-submit split, the jobs bump and the done_prepare phase reorder; all three are recorded as excluded scope and left to follow-on stories.
